name: Armin Shroff
about:
I bring together psychological understanding and over 30 years of experience in education, mentoring and working with people. 
With an MA in Psychology and training in CBT,REBT and SFBT. I offer an empathetic, practical and non-judgmental approach to counselling. I am particularly interested in helping individuals navigate stress, understand their emotions, build self-esteem, develop helpful thinking patterns and strengthen relationships. 
I believe counselling is not about providing ready-made answers, but about creating a safe space for reflection, self-discovery and meaningful change. 
As founder of AllzWellEver, my philosophy is “Prepare Rather Than Repair”—encouraging emotional awareness, resilience and wellbeing before challenges become overwhelming.
achievements:
- Founder of AllzWellEver, a preventive mental health and emotional wellness initiative built around the philosophy “Prepare Rather Than Repair.”
- Positively impacted over 10,000 individuals through workshops, training and wellness initiatives.
- Over 30 years of experience in education, training, mentoring and facilitating personal development.
- Delivered workshops and programmes for corporate organisations, educational institutions, teachers, parents and students.
- Experience in designing practical, interactive programmes on emotional wellbeing, communication skills, life skills and personal growth.
whatBringsYou:
My approach combines psychological understanding with over 30 years of experience in education, mentoring and working with people. I draw on CBT,REBT and SFBT principles to help individuals recognise the connection between their thoughts, emotions and behaviours. 

Rather than offering ready-made solutions, I encourage self-reflection, helpful thinking and practical steps that fit each person's circumstances. I value empathy over judgement, collaboration over instruction, and progress over perfection. 

My focus is on helping individuals recognise their strengths, build emotional resilience and develop skills they can use in everyday life. Guided by my philosophy, “Prepare Rather Than Repair,” I believe that greater self-awareness can help us respond to life's challenges more constructively.

Through these programs, he successfully educated students about mental health, effectively reducing the associated stigma and fostering a more empathetic and supportive environment. Another commendable aspect of Mr. Pradhan's work is his dedication to assisting individuals battling drug and alcohol addiction. His contributions in this area have had a transformative impact on the lives of those struggling with substance abuse. Currently, Mr. Pradhan provides counseling services to vulnerable patients in hospitals, offering support in carrying out their daily responsibilities and recovering from challenging circumstances. His goal is to enhance their quality of life and restore their dignity. Furthermore, he extends his expertise to the corporate world, providing therapy and support to individuals seeking a healthy work-life balance. By facilitating personal and professional growth, he enables individuals to lead more meaningful and satisfying lives both inside and outside of the workplace. Mr. Pradhan's wealth of experience and versatile counseling skills make him an invaluable asset to any community or organization he serves. His ability to connect with people from all walks of life is a testament to his exceptional interpersonal skills and empathetic nature.
